Now Platform

Who is it for?

If your organization is already using ServiceNow — ITSM, ITOM, or CSM — it's an ideal time to leverage the Now Platform. Exterprise's team of experts will:

Now Platform
1

Design

Use App Engine Studio to customize user and process flows and map them to ServiceNow components and modules — visually, without hand-coding the scaffolding.

2

Develop & Integrate

Flow Designer automates the process logic while IntegrationHub connects the new application to other line-of-business systems — no separate integration project required.

3

Deploy

Ensure the custom application can be deployed within minutes, inside the ServiceNow framework — with AI Control Tower governance applied from day one.
